blocks.text: Catriona Gray is set to grace the Victoria Secret fashion show in Los Angeles, California as a special guest and as representative of the Philippines. The Miss Universe 2018 titleholder announced on social media her participation on the Victoria Secret event on October 19, though it is not clear whether she would be sashaying on the famous linerie line with her signature lava walk. “Wings up, we’re inbound,” Gray simply said as caption to a series of old photos that she posted anew on Instagram, in which she was wearing a platinum blond wig and a baby pink leotards.
